blocks.text: Ek aam baligh (adult) insan ka dil ek minute mein taqreeban 70 dafa dharakta hai. Yeh har minute jism ka saara khoon (taqreeban 5 litre) pump kar deta hai. Dharkan ki normal raftar pacemaker aur AV node banate aur qaim rakhte hain. Dimagh (brain) bhi dil ki raftar par kuch asar dalta hai. Maslan bukhar aur warzish (exercise) mein dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node dono ko nerve signals bhejta hai aur dil ki raftar barh jati hai, taake jism us halat ka muqabla kar sake. Is ke ulat jab hum so rahe hon ya aaram kar rahe hon to dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node ka kaam dheema kar deta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Ek baligh insan mein har roz taqreeban 8,000 litre khoon 96,000 km lambi khoon ki naliyon mein se guzarta hai.
